selection: Four lowest eligible whole auxiliary TRAIN seeds, one per map, already chosen using only past/current observable damage. No development, previous32fresh audit worlds, alternative outcomes or prediction scores in selection.
intervention: Fixed movement mean shifts on [F,F+5), same original root Gaussian/fire draw. Future policy RNG fork at F+1, three predefined31bit seeds, temporal memory and environment RNG not reset. Future aim/fire recompute from actual movement. No NN/std/critic changes.
controls: Each context/stream has fork-only ordinary_reference and zero-shift control; require full exact equality. One ordinary_no_fork per context must exactly repeat source baseline. All streams require exact reference prefix including root and ordinary baseline. All variant prefix/state/categories/root draws and common future draw receipts verified. No posthoc goal-tail supplement in this pilot; failures retained.
local_admission: Only accepted prefix/root/draw controls, exclusive consecutive first-life provider native windows with available effects, and same-life endpoint observation supply H1/3/5/10/20 effects. Unknown windows/terminal tails masked, not filled. Full-episode admission remains a separate strict check; local labels cannot imply final quality.
analysis: For each alternative report incoming and outgoing HP deltas versus same-stream control, three-stream mean/sampleSD/range/sign changes at H5/H10. Variants within world and repeated policy streams are dependent, not new environment seeds.

pilot_signal.selection: Minimum mean observed cost on first2streams, ties by fixed action_order; never select using third stream or final episode outcome.

next: Only technical acceptance plus fixed held-stream pilot signal supports scaling independent auxiliary TRAIN/development branching data. This is not model admission, expected-Q proof or combat-policy superiority. No fitting in this pilot; keep negative and unknown results.
